original_task_instruction: Jordan Lee is visiting, so please prepare the Guest room using the saved contact preferences, Calendar timing, current SmartHome state, and `/tmp/visit/standard.xlsx`. Schedule the preparation workflow and send Jordan a concise confirmation with the Guest room, preparation time, temperature, light level, and air-purifier setting. Also create `/tmp/visit/record.docx` titled `Visitor record` with a readable two-column summary labeled `Visitor`, `Room`, `Workflow time`, `Temperature`, `Light`, and `Air purifier`.
stage_goal: On the current device, inspect `/tmp/visit/standard.xlsx`. Report every visitor preference-to-device-setting rule needed for room preparation and the preparation lead time. Do not modify the workbook. When finished, submit the `done` action and put the concrete requested information in `observation_description.report` in that same final response. Do not leave the result only in `thought`.

required_semantics: the visitor preference-to-device-setting rules and preparation lead time in the workbook
